QUOTE: Add a `#define MBEDTLS_ERR_<MODULE>_<NAME>` with a negative value to the module's public header (for example `include/mbedtls/aes.h`)... Do not edit the `case` lines in `library/error.c`. They are regenerated at build time from the headers, so a manual edit is lost.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer gives the header-define and don't-edit-error.c parts, but it never says the define must be /** */-documented or that the description comes from that doc comment. It also explicitly says it could not verify where the description text comes from.
